notesStmt.note: Kāśikāvṛtti 1.1.1–75: A Romanized Text for Study Prepared by Adam Alvah Catt, Kyoto University Last updated <December 13, 2021> • This is a corrected and lightly annotated text based on Sharma, Aryendra, Khanderao Deshpande, and D. G. Padhye (1969) Kāśikā: A Commentary on Pāṇini’s Grammar. Part I: Adhyāyas 1–4. Hyderabad: Sanskrit Academy, Osmania University • Bold numbers in brackets ([p. 1]) refer to page numbers in Sharma et al. 1969 • Example words or phrases illustrating the application of sūtras etc. are given in italics • I have split the text into coherent sections or paragraphs so that the structure of the commentary is clearer (for example, I place a line break before the first set of examples given under each sūtra) • To indicate optionality among forms, I have introduced the symbol ~ • Note that the sandhi (and punctuation) generally follows that of Sharma et al. 1969, although their edition is inconsistent in its application of sandhi

text.body:
[p. 5] vṛddhir ādaic || 1.1.1 || vṛddhiśabdaḥ sañjñātvena vidhīyate, pratyekam ādaicāṃ varṇānāṃ sāmānyena tadbhāvitānām, atadbhāvitānāṃ ca | taparakaraṇam aijartham tād api paraḥ taparaḥ iti, khaṭvaiḍakādiṣu trimātracaturmātraprasaṅganivṛttaye | āśvalāyanaḥ | aitikāyanaḥ | aupagavaḥ | aupamanyavaḥ | śālīyaḥ | mālīyaḥ | vṛddhipradeśāḥ — “sici vṛddhiḥ parasmaipadeṣu” (7.2.1) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ adeṅ guṇaḥ || 1.1.2 || guṇaśabdaḥ sañjñātvena vidhīyate, pratyekam adeṅāṃ varṇānāṃ sāmānyena tadbhāvitānām, atadbhāvitānāṃ ca | taparakaraṇaṃ tv iha sarvārtham | taritā | cetā | stotā | jayanti | ahaṃ pace | guṇapradeśāḥ — “mider guṇaḥ” (7.3.82) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ iko guṇavṛddhī || 1.1.3 || paribhāṣā iyaṃ sthāniniyamārthā | aniyamaprasaṅge niyamo vidhīyate | vṛddhiguṇau svasañjñayā śiṣyamāṇau ikaḥ eva sthāne veditavyau | vakṣyati — “sārvadhātukārdhadhātukayoḥ” (7.3.84) aṅgasya guṇa iti | sa iko eva sthāne veditavyaḥ | tarati | nayati | bhavati | [p. 7] vṛddhiḥ khalv api — akārṣīt | ahārṣīt | acaiṣīt | anaiṣīt | alāvīt | astāvīt | guṇavṛddhī svasañjñayā vidhīyete, tatra ikaḥ iti etad upasthitaṃ draṣṭavyam | kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati? dvitīyayā ṣaṣṭhī prādurbhāvyate (MBhāṣ 1.46) | midimṛjipugantalaghūpardhacchidṛśikṣiprakṣudreṣv aṅgena ig viśeṣyate (MBhāṣ 1.44) | jusi sārvadhātukādiguṇeṣu ikāṅgaṃ viśeṣyate | medyate | abibhayuḥ | ikaḥ iti kim? ātsandhyakṣaravyañjanānāṃ mā bhūt (MBhāṣ 1.42) | yānam | glāyati | umbhitā | punar guṇavṛddhigrahaṇaṃ svasañjñayā vidhāne niyamārtham | iha mā bhūt — dyauḥ, panthāḥ, saḥ, imam iti (MBhāṣ 1.43) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ na dhātulopa ārdhadhātuke || 1.1.4 || dhātvekadeśo dhātuḥ, tasya lopo yasminn ārdhadhātuke tadārdhadhātukaṃ dhātulopaṃ, tatra ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ, te na bhavataḥ | 1 loluvaḥ | popuvaḥ | marīmṛjaḥ (MBhāṣ 1.51) | lolūyādibhyo yaṅantebhyaḥ pacādyaci (3.1.134) vihite “yaṅo 'ci ca” (2.4.74) iti yaṅo luki kṛte tam evācam āśritya ye guṇavṛddhī prāpte tayoḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | dhātugrahaṇaṃ kim? lūñ (Dhp. 9.13), lavitā | réḍ asi (VS 6.18) | parṇáṃ ná véḥ (RV 4.40.3b) | anubandhapratyayalope mā bhūt | riṣer hi sārthasya vic-pratyayalopa udāharaṇaṃ réṭ (VS 6.18) iti | ārdhadhātuke iti kim? trídhā baddhó vṛṣabhó roravīti (RV 4.58.3c) iti | sārvadhātuke mā bhūt | ikaḥ ity eva — abhāji, rāgaḥ | bahuvrīhisamāśrayaṇaṃ kim? knopayati, preddham || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ kṅiti ca || 1.1.5 || nimittasaptamy eṣā | kṅinnimitte ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ, te na bhavataḥ (MBhāṣ 1.53) | citaḥ, citavān | stutaḥ, stutavān | bhinnaḥ, bhinnavān | mṛṣṭaḥ, mṛṣṭavān | ṅiti khalv api — cinutaḥ, cinvanti | mṛṣṭaḥ, mṛjanti | gakāro 'pi atra cartvabhūto nirdiśyate | “glājisthaś ca gsnuḥ” (3.2.139) jiṣṇuḥ | bhūṣṇuḥ | ikaḥ ity eva — kāmayate, laigavāyanaḥ (MBhāṣ 1.55) | mṛjer ajādau saṅkrame vibhāṣā vṛddhir iṣyate (MBhāṣ 1.48) | [p. 8] saṅkramo nāma guṇavṛddhipratiṣedhaviṣayaḥ | parimṛjanti ~ parimārjanti | parimṛjantu ~ parimārjantu | laghūpadhaguṇasyāpy atra pratiṣedhaḥ | acinavam, asunavam ityādau lakārasya saty api ṅittve yāsuṭo ṅidvacanaṃ jñāpakam ṅiti yat kāryaṃ tal lakāre ṅiti na bhavati iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ dīdhīvevīṭām || 1.1.6 || dīdhīvevyoḥ iṭaś ca ye guṇavṛddhī prāpnutaḥ, te na bhavataḥ | ādīdhyanam, ādīdhyakaḥ | āvevyanam, āvevyakaḥ | iṭaḥ khalv api — kaṇitā śvaḥ | raṇitā śvaḥ | vṛddhir iṭo na saṃbhavati iti laghūpadhaguṇasyātra pratiṣedhaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ halo 'nantarāḥ saṃyogaḥ || 1.1.7 || bhinnajātīyair ajbhir avyavahitāḥ śliṣṭoccāritā halaḥ saṃyogasañjñā bhavanti | samudāyaḥ sañjñī | jātau cedaṃ bahuvacanam | tena dvayor bahūnāṃ ca saṃyogasañjñā siddhā bhavati | agniḥ iti ganau | aśvaḥ iti śavau | karṇaḥ iti raṇau | indraḥ, candraḥ, mandraḥ iti nadarāḥ | uṣṭraḥ, rāṣṭram, bhrāṣṭram iti ṣaṭarāḥ | tilān stry āvapati iti nasatarayāḥ, natasatarayā vā | halaḥ iti kim? +titau chattram (for titaucchatram) (cf. Nirukta 4.9.10) — “saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ” (8.2.23) iti lopaḥ syāt | anantarāḥ iti kim? pacati panasam — “skoḥ saṃyogādyor ante ca” (8.2.29) iti lopaḥ syāt | saṃyogapradeśāḥ — “saṃyogāntasya lopaḥ” (8.2.23) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ mukhanāsikāvacano 'nunāsikaḥ || 1.1.8 || 2 mukhasahitā nāsikā mukhanāsikā, tayā ya uccāryate varṇaḥ so 'nunāsikasañjño bhavati | “āṅo 'nunāsikaś chandasi” (6.1.126) | abhrá ,ṃ apáḥ (RV 5.48.1cd) | gabhīrá ,ṃ úgraputre (RV 8.67.11ab) | ca na āṃ indraḥ (source?) | mukhagrahaṇaṃ kim? anusvārasyaiva hi syāt | nāsikāgrahaṇaṃ kim? kacaṭatapānāṃ mā bhūt | anunāsikapradeśāḥ — “āṅo 'nunāsikaś chandasi” (6.1.26) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ tulyāsyaprayatnaṃ savarṇam || 1.1.9 || tulyaśabdaḥ sadṛśaparyāyaḥ | āsye bhavam āsyaṃ tālvādisthānam | prayatanaṃ prayatnaḥ spṛṣṭatādir varṇaguṇaḥ | tulya [p. 9] āsye prayatno yasya varṇasya yena varṇena saha sa samānajātīyaṃ prati savarṇasañjño bhavati | catvāra ābhyantarāḥ prayatnāḥ savarṇasaṃjñāyām āśrīyante — spṛṣṭatā, īṣatspṛṣṭatā, saṃvṛtatā, vivṛtatā ca iti | a a a iti trayo 'kārā udāttānudāttasvaritāḥ pratyekaṃ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāś ca hrasvadīrghaplutabhedād aṣṭādaśadhā bhidyante | tathā ivarṇaḥ, tathā uvarṇaḥ, tathā ṛvarṇaḥ | ḷvarṇasya dīrghā na santi (Āpiśali Śikṣā 6.4), taṃ dvādaśabhedam ācakśate | sandhyakṣarāṇāṃ hrasvā na santi, tāny api dvādaśaprabhedāni | antaḥsthā dviprabhedāḥ, rephavarjitā yavalāḥ sānunāsikā niranunāsikāś ca | rephoṣmaṇāṃ savarṇā na santi | vargyo vargyeṇa savarṇaḥ (Āpiśali Śikṣā 6.11,13) | daṇḍāgram | khaṭvāgram | āsyagrahaṇaṃ kim? kacaṭatapānāṃ bhinnasthānānāṃ tulyaprayatnānāṃ mā bhūt | kiṃ ca syāt? tarptā, tarptum ity atra “jharo jhari savarṇe” (8.4.65) iti pakārasya takāre lopaḥ syāt | prayatnagrahaṇaṃ kim? icuyaśānāṃ tulyasthānānāṃ bhinnajātīyānāṃ mā bhūt | kiṃ ca syāt? aruś cyotati ity atra “jharo jhari savarṇe” (8.4.65) iti śakārasya cakāre lopaḥ syāt | [3] “ṛkāraḷkārayoḥ savarṇasañjñā” vaktavyā (MBhāṣ I.62) | hotṛ, ḷkāraḥ | hotṝkāraḥ | ubhayoḥ ṛvarṇasya ḷvarṇasya ca āntaratamaḥ savarṇo dīrgho nāsti iti ṛkāra eva dīrgho bhavati | savarṇapradeśāḥ — “akaḥ savarṇe dīrghaḥ” (6.1.101) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ nājjhalau || 1.1.10 || ac ca hal ca, ajjhalau | tulyāsyaprayatnāv api ajjhalau parasparaṃ savarṇasañjñau na bhavataḥ | avarṇahakārau daṇḍahastaḥ, ivarṇaśakārau dadhiśītam, savarṇadīrghatvaṃ na bhavati | vaipāśo matsyaḥ, ānaḍuhaṃ carma iti “yasyeti ca” (6.4.148) iti lopo na bhavati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 10] īdūded dvivacanaṃ pragṛhyam || 1.1.11 || īt ūt et ity evamantaṃ dvivacanaṃ śabdarūpaṃ pragṛhyasañjñaṃ bhavati | agnī iti | vāyū iti | māle iti | pacete iti | īdūdet iti kim? vṛkṣāv atra | plakṣāv atra | dvivacanam iti kim? kumāry atra | kiśory atra | taparakaraṇam asaṃdehārtham | pragṛhyapradeśāḥ — “plutapragṛhyā aci nityam” (6.1.125) ity evamādayaḥ | īdādīnāṃ pragṛhyatve maṇīvādīnāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ | maṇīvoṣṭrasya lambete priyau vatsatarau mama (Mahābhārata 12.171.12ab) | dámpatīva (RV 2.39.2d) | jampatīva | rodasīva || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ 3 adaso māt || 1.1.12 || adasaḥ +sambandhī (for sambadhī) yo makāras tasmāt pare īdūdetaḥ pragṛhyasañjñā bhavanti (MBhāṣ 1.68) | amī atra | amī āsate | amū atra | amū āsāte | ekārasya udāharaṇaṃ nāsti | adasaḥ iti kim? śamy atra | dāḍimy atra | māt iti kim? amuke 'tra || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ śe || 1.1.13 || śe ity etat pragṛhyasañjñaṃ bhavati | kim idaṃ śe iti? supām ādeśaś chandasi | ná yuṣmé vājabandhavaḥ (RV 8.68.19a) | asmé indrābṛhaspatī (RV 4.49.4a) | yuṣmé íti (RV Padapāṭha) | asmé íti (RV Padapāṭha) | tvé r,yaḥ (RV 1.169.5a, VS 4.22; TS 3.2.5.2 in Sharma is a mistake) | mé r,yaḥ (VS 4.22) | tvé íti (RV Padapāṭha; TS Padapāṭha in Sharma is a mistake) | mé íti (VS Padapāṭha) | chāndasam etad evaikam udāharaṇam — asmé indrābṛhaspatī iti | tatra tathā pāṭhāt | itarat tu laukikam anukaraṇam — yuṣmé íti, asmé íti, tvé íti, mé íti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ nipāta ekāj anāṅ || 1.1.14 || ekaś cāsāv ac ca ekāc, nipāto ya ekāc āṅ-varjitaḥ sa pragṛhyasañjño bhavati | a apehi | i indraṃ paśya | u uttiṣṭha | ā evaṃ nu manyase (MBhāṣ 1.71) | ā evaṃ kila tat (MBhāṣ 1.71) | nipātaḥ iti kim? cakārātra | jahārātra | ekāc iti kim? pr,gnáye v,cam īraya (RV 10.187.1a) | anāṅ iti kim? ā + udakāntāt > odakāntāt | īṣadarthe kriyāyoge maryādābhividhau ca yaḥ | etam ātaṃ ṅitaṃ vidyād vākyasmaraṇayor aṅit || (MBhāṣ 1.71) ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 11] ot || 1.1.15 || nipātaḥ iti vartate | tasyaukāreṇa tadantavidhiḥ | odanto yo nipātaḥ sa pragṛhyasañjño bhavati | āho iti | utāho iti (MBhāṣ 1.71) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ sambuddhau śākalyasyetāv anārṣe || 1.1.16 || ot iti vartate | sambuddhinimitto ya okāraḥ sa śākalyasya ācāryasya matena pragṛhyasañjño bhavati, itiśabde anārṣe avaidike parataḥ | vāyo iti ~ vāyav iti | bhāno iti ~ bhānav iti | sambuddhau iti kim? gav ity ayam āha | atrānukāryānukaraṇayoḥ bhedasyāvivakṣitatvāt, asaty arthavattve vibhaktir na bhavati | śākalyagrahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārtham | itau iti kim? vāyo 'tra | anārṣe iti kim? etā gā brahmabandha ity abravīt (KS 10.6) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ 4 uñaḥ || 1.1.17 || śākalyasyetau anārṣe iti vartate | uñaḥ pragṛhyasañjñā bhavati itau śākalyasyācāryasya matena | śākalyasya iti vibhāṣārtham | u iti ~ v iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ ū1 || 1.1.18 || uñaḥ iti vartate | uñaḥ itāv anārṣe ū1 ity ayam ādeśo bhavati dīrgho 'nunāsikaś ca, śākalyasya matena pragṛhyasañjñakaś ca | śākalyasya grahaṇaṃ vibhāṣārtham ihāpy anuvartate | tena trīṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti — u iti ~ v iti ~ ū/ iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ īdūtau ca saptamyarthe || 1.1.19 || śākalyasyetāv anārṣe iti nivṛttam | īdantam ūdantaṃ ca śabdarūpaṃ saptamyarthe vartamānam pragṛhyasañjñaṃ bhavati | adhy asyām māmakī tanū (AVP +6.6.8d [Sharma: 1.6.8]) | māmakyāṃ tanvām iti prāpte, māmakyām māmakī iti, tanvāṃ tanū iti | sómo gaur0 ádhi śritáḥ (RV 9.12.3c) | īdūtau iti kim? priyáḥ s1rye priyó agn, bhavāti (RV 5.37.5c) | agniśabdāt parasyāḥ saptamyāḥ ḍādeśaḥ | saptamīgrahaṇaṃ kim? dhītī, matī, suṣṭutī — dhītyā, matyā, suṣṭutyā iti prāpte | arthagrahaṇaṃ kim? vāpyaśvaḥ | nadyātiḥ | taparakaraṇam asandehārtham | [p. 12] īdūtau saptamīty eva lupte 'rthagrahaṇād bhavet | pūrvasya cet savarṇo 'sāv āḍāmbhāvaḥ prasajyate ||1|| vacanādy atra dīrghatvaṃ tatrāpi sarasī yadi | jñāpakaṃ syāt tadantatve mā vā pūrvapadasya bhūt ||2|| (MBhāṣ 1.73) ___________________________________________________________________________________________ dādhā ghv adāp || 1.1.20 || dārūpāś catvāro dhātavaḥ, dhārūpau ca dvau dābdaipau varjayitvā ghusañjñakā bhavanti | “ḍudāñ” (Dhp. III.9 [Sharma: 1091]) — praṇidadāti | “dāṇ” (Dhp. I.977 [Sharma: 930]) — praṇidātā | “do” (Dhp. IV.40 [Sharma: 1148]) — praṇidyati | “deṅ” (Dhp. I.1011 [Sharma: 962]) — praṇidayate | “ḍudhāñ” (Dhp. III.10 [Sharma: 1092]) — praṇidadhāti | “dheṭ” (Dhp. I.951 [Sharma: 902]) — praṇidhayati vatso mātaram | adāp iti kim? “dāp lavane” (Dhp. II.50 [Sharma: 1059]) — dātam barhiḥ | “daip śodhane” (Dhp. I.971 [Sharma: 924]) — avadātam mukham | ghupradeśāḥ — “ghumāsthāgāpājahātisāṃ hali” (6.4.66) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ ādyantavad ekasmin || 1.1.21 || asahāyasya ādyantopadiṣṭāni kāryāṇi na sidhyanti iti ayam atideśa ārabhyate | saptamyarthe vatiḥ | ādāv iva ante iva ekasminn api kāryam bhavati | yathā kartávyam ity atra pratyayādyudāttatvam bhavati (3.1.3), evam aupagavám ity atrāpi yathā syāt | yathā vṛkṣābhyām ity atra ato 'ṅgasya dīrghatvam (7.3.102), evam ābhyām ity atrāpi yathā syāt | 5 ekasminn iti kim? sabhāsaṃnayane bhavaḥ sābhāsaṃnayanaḥ, ākāram āśritya vṛddhasañjñā na bhavati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ taraptamapau ghaḥ || 1.1.22 || tarap tamap ity etau pratyayau ghasañjñau bhavataḥ | kumāritarā | kumāritamā | brāhmaṇitarā | brāhmaṇitamā | ghapradeśāḥ — “gharūpakalpacelaḍbruvagotramatahateṣu ṅyo 'nekāco hrasvaḥ” (6.3.43) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ bahugaṇavatuḍati saṅkhyā || 1.1.23 || bahu gaṇa vatu ḍati (5.2.39) ity ete saṅkhyāsañjñā bhavanti | bahukṛtvaḥ (5.4.17) | bahudhā (5.3.42) | bahukaḥ (5.1.22) | bahuśaḥ (5.4.43) | gaṇakṛtvaḥ | gaṇadhā | gaṇakaḥ | gaṇaśaḥ | tāvatkṛtvaḥ | tāvaddhā | tāvatkaḥ | tāvacchaḥ | katikṛtvaḥ | katidhā | katikaḥ | katiśaḥ | bahugaṇaśabdayor vaipulye saṅghe ca vartamānayor iha grahaṇaṃ nāsti, saṅkhyāvācinor eva | bhūryādīnāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ saṅkhyāsañjñā vidhīyate | [p. 13] [4] ardhapūrvapadaś ca pūraṇapratyayāntaḥ saṅkhyāsañjño bhavatīti vaktavyaṃ samāsakanvidhyartham | (MBhāṣ 1.82) ardhapañcamaśūrpaḥ | ardham pañcamaṃ yeṣām iti bahuvrīhau kṛte ardhapañcamaiḥ śūrpaiḥ krītaḥ | taddhitārtheti (2.1.51) samāsaḥ | tatra “diksaṅkhye sañjñāyām” (2.1.50) ity anuvṛttes tataḥ saṅkhyāpūrvasya dvigusañjñāyāṃ (2.1.52) “śūrpād añ anyatarasyām” (5.1.26) iti añ ṭhañ ca | “adhyardhapūrvadvigor lug asañjñāyām” (5.1.28) iti luk | ardhapañcamakaḥ (5.1.22) | saṅkhyāpradeśāḥ — “saṅkhyā vaṃśyena” (2.1.19) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 12] ṣṇāntā ṣaṭ || 1.1.24 || strīliṅganirdeśāt saṅkhyā iti sambadhyate | ṣakārāntā nakārāntā ca yā saṅkhyā sā ṣaṭsañjñā bhavati | ṣakārāntā tāvat — ṣaṭ tiṣṭhanti | ṣaṭ paśya | nakārāntaḥ — pañca | sapta | nava | daśa | antagrahaṇam aupadeśikārtham | teneha na bhavati — śatāni, sahasrāṇi | aṣṭānām ŚBM 3.3.4.17–19) | atra 7 subrahmaṇyom ity okāras titsvareṇa svaritas tasyodātto vidhīyate | indra āgaccha ity āmantritam ādyudattam | dvitīyo varṇo 'nudāttaḥ | “udāttād anudāttasya svaritaḥ” (8.4.66) iti svaritaḥ prasaktas tasyānenodāttaḥ kriyate | tena dvāv apy udāttau sampannau | āgaccha ity ākāra udāttaḥ tataḥ paro 'nudāttaḥ svaritas tasyānenodāttaḥ kriyate | tad evam indra āgaccha iti catvāra udāttāḥ | paścima eko 'nudāttaḥ | hariva āgaccha ity anayaiva prakriyayā catvāra udāttāḥ dvāv anudāttau | medhātitheḥ iti ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ param āmantritam anupraviśati “sub āmantrite parāṅgavat svare” (2.1.2) iti | tataḥ sakalasyāmantritādyudāttatve kṛte dvitīyam akṣaram anudāttaṃ, tasya “udāttād anudāttasya svaritaḥ” (8.4.66) iti svaritatve prāpte idam udāttatvaṃ [p. 41] vidhīyate | tena dvāv apy udāttau bhavataḥ | śeṣam anudāttam | vṛṣaṇaśvasya mene iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa | gaurāvaskandin iti tathaiva dve ādye akṣare udātte, śeṣam anudāttam | ahalyāyai jāra iti subantasyāmantritānupraveśāt tadvad eva svaraḥ | dvāv udāttau śeṣam anudāttam | kauśikabrāhmaṇa iti samastam āmantritam ādyudāttaṃ tatra pūrvavad dvāv udāttau śeṣam anudāttam | evaṃ gautamabruvāṇa iti dvāv udāttau śeṣam anudāttam | śvaḥ sutyām āgaccha maghavan iti śvaḥśabda udāttaḥ sutyām ity antodāttaḥ | “sañjñāyāṃ samajaniṣadanipatamanavidaṣuñ śīṅbhṛñiṇaḥ” (3.3.99) iti kyapo vidhāne udāttaḥ iti vartate | āgaccha iti dvāv udāttau | antyo 'nudāttaḥ | maghavan iti padāt param āmantritaṃ nihanyate || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ devabrahmaṇor anudāttaḥ || 1.2.38 || subrahmaṇyāyām eva “devā brahmāṇaḥ” iti paṭhyate, tatra pūrveṇa svaritasyodātte prāpte 'nenānudātto vidhīyate | devabrahmaṇoḥ svaritasyānudātta ādeśo bhavati | dévā bráhmāṇa -gacchata (cf. ŚBM 3.3.4.20) | dvayor api padayor āmantritādyudāttatve śeṣanighāte codāttād anudāttasya svaritaḥ kṛtas tasyānudātto bhavati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ svaritāt saṃhitāyām anudāttānām || 1.2.39 || ekaśrutiḥ iti vartate | saṃhitāyāṃ viṣaye svaritāt pareṣām anudāttānām ekaśrutir bhavati | imáṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati | śútudri (RV 10.75.5ab) | m-ṇavaka jaṭilakādhyāpaka kvà gamiṣyasi | imam ity antodāttaṃ, me iti anudāttaṃ vidhikāla eva nighātavidhānāt | tat punaḥ “udāttād anudāttasya svaritaḥ” (8.4.66) iti svaritaṃ sampadyate | tasmāt svaritāt pareṣām anudāttānāṃ gaṅgeprabhṛtīnām ekaśrutir bhavati | sarva ete āmantritanighātena anudāttāḥ | māṇavaka jaṭilaka iti prathamam āmantritam ādyudāttaṃ, tasya dvitīyam akṣaraṃ svaritaṃ, tataḥ pareṣām anudāttānām ekaśrutir bhavati | saṃhitāgrahaṇaṃ kim? avagrahe mā bhūt | imáṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati (RV 10.75.5a) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ udāttasvaritaparasya sannataraḥ || 1.2.40 || anudāttagrahaṇam anuvartate | udāttaḥ paro yasmāt sa udāttaparaḥ | svaritaḥ paro yasmāt sa svaritaparaḥ | udāttaparasya svaritaparasya cānudāttasya sannatara ādeśo bhavati | anudāttataraḥ ity arthaḥ | devā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaro 'páḥ (AVP 3.31.1) | mātaraḥ ity anudāttaḥ | apaḥ ity antodāttaḥ “ūḍidampadādyappumraidyubhyaḥ” (6.1.171) iti | tatrānudāttayor ekādeśa okāro 'nudāttaḥ | tasyodātte parabhūte sannatara ādeśo bhavati | imáṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati | śútudri [p. 42] (RV 10.75.5ab) | ikāro 'nudāttaḥ | śutudri ity etad āmantritaṃ pādādau tasmān na nihanyate, “anudāttaṃ sarvam apādādau” (8.1.18) iti | tasya prathamam akṣaram udāttaṃ tasmin parabhūte pūrvasya sarasvati iti ikārasya sannatara ādeśo bhavati | m-ṇavaka jaṭilakādhyāpaka kvà gamiṣyasi | kvà iti svaritas tasmin parabhūte ka iti anudāttas tasya sannatara ādeśo bhavati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ apṛkta ekāl pratyayaḥ || 1.2.41 || apṛktaḥ iti iyaṃ sañjñā bhavati ekāl yaḥ pratyayas tasya | asahāyavācī ekaśabdaḥ | “spṛśo 'nudake kvin” (3.2.58) — ghṛtaspṛk | “bhajo ṇviḥ” (3.2.62) — ardhabhāk | pādabhāk | ekāl iti kim? darviḥ (US IV.53) | jāgṛviḥ (US IV.54, MBh to vt. 4 [I.213]) | pratyaya iti kim? surāḥ | apṛktapradeśāḥ — “ver apṛktasya” (6.1.67) ity evamādayaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇaḥ karmadhārayaḥ || 1.2.42 || 8 tatpuruṣaḥ (2.1.22) iti samāsaviśeṣasya sañjñāṃ vakṣyati | sa tatpuruṣaḥ samānādhikaraṇapadaḥ karmadhārayasañjño bhavati | adhikaraṇaśabdo 'bhidheyavāci | samānādhikaraṇaḥ samānābhidheyaḥ | paramarājyám | uttamarājyám | “akarmadhāraye rājyam” (6.2.130) ity uttarapadādyudāttaṃ na bhavati | pācakavṛndārikā (6.3.42) | tatpuruṣaḥ iti kim? sañjñāpramāṇatvāt | sañjñāśabdā hi nānāliṅgasaṅkhyāḥ pramāṇam | pañcālāḥ, varaṇā iti ca, naite yogaśabdāḥ | kiṃ tarhi? janapadādīnāṃ sañjñā etāḥ | tatra liṅgaṃ vacanaṃ ca svabhāvasaṃsiddham eva na yatnapratipādyam, yathā āpaḥ, dārāḥ, gṛhāḥ, sikatāḥ, varṣāḥ iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ lub yogāprakhyānāt || 1.2.54 || lub apy aśiṣyaḥ | yo 'yaṃ “janapade lup” (4.2.81), “varaṇādibhyaś ca” (4.2.82) iti [p. 46] lub ucyate, ayaṃ na vaktavyaḥ | kiṃ kāraṇam? karoter ātmanepadaṃ bhavati | gandhanam apakāraprayuktaṃ hiṃsātmakaṃ sūcanam | tathā hi, “basta gandha ardane” (DhP X.145), “arda hiṃsāyām” (DhP X.285) iti curādau paṭhyate | avakṣepaṇaṃ bhartsanam | sevanam anuvṛttiḥ | sāhasikyaṃ sāhasikaṃ karma | pratiyatnaḥ sato guṇāntarādhānam | prakathanaṃ prakarṣeṇa kathanam | upayogo dharmādiprayojano viniyogaḥ | gandhane tāvat — utkurute | udākurute | sūcayati ity arthaḥ | avakṣepaṇe — śyeno vartikām udākurute | bhartsayati ity arthaḥ | sevane — gaṇakān upakurute | mahāmātrān upakurute | sevate ity arthaḥ | [p. 60] sāhasikye — paradārān prakurute | teṣu sahasā pravartate ity arthaḥ | pratiyatne — edho dakasyopaskurute | kāṇḍaṃ guḍasyopaskurute | tasya sato guṇāntarādhānaṃ karoti ity arthaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīsuṭau karoteḥ pratiyatna eva vidhīyete (2.3.53, 6.1.139) | prakathane — gāthāḥ prakurute | janāpavādān prakurute | prakarṣeṇa kathayati ity arthaḥ | upayoge — śatam prakurute | sahasraṃ prakurute | dharmārthaṃ śataṃ viniyuṅkte ity arthaḥ | eteṣu iti kim? kaṭaṃ karoti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ adheḥ prasahane || 1.3.33 || akartrabhiprāyārtho ’yam ārambhaḥ | adhipūrvāt karoteḥ upasargaviśeṣaṇārtham || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ veḥ śabdakarmaṇaḥ || 1.3.34 || kṛñaḥ ity anuvartate | vipūrvāt karoter kartrabhiprāye kriyāphale siddham evātmanepadam | akartrabhiprāyārtho ’yam ārambhaḥ | ṇīñ prāpaṇe ity etasmāt dhātor ātmanepadaṃ bhavati sammānanādiṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu satsu | sammānanaṃ pūjanam — nayate cārvī lokāyate | cārvī buddhiḥ, tatsambandhād ācārye ’pi cārvī | sa lokāyate śāstre padārthān nayate, upapattibhiḥ sthirīkṛtya śiṣyebhyaḥ prāpayati | te yuktibhiḥ sthāpyamānāḥ sammānitāḥ pūjitā bhavanti | utsañjanam utkṣepaṇam — māṇavakam udānayate | utkṣipati ity arthaḥ | ācāryakaraṇam ācāryakriyā — māṇavakam īdṛśena vidhinā ātmasamīpaṃ prāpayati yathā sa upanetā svayam ācāryaḥ sampadyate | māṇavakam upanayate | ātmānam ācāryīkurvan māṇavakam ātmasamīpaṃ prāpayati ity arthaḥ | jñānaṃ prameyaniścayaḥ — nayate cārvī lokāyate | tatra prameyaṃ niścinoti ity arthaḥ | bhṛtir vetanam — karmakarān upanayate | bhṛtidānena samīpaṃ karoti ity arthaḥ | vigaṇanam ṛṇāder niryātanam — madrāḥ karam vinayante | niryātayanti ity arthaḥ | vyayo dharmādiṣu viniyogaḥ | śataṃ vinayate | sahasraṃ vinayate | dharmādyarthaṃ śatam viniyuṅkte ity arthaḥ | eteṣu iti kim? ajāṃ nayati grāmam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 61] kartṛsthe cāśarīre karmaṇi || 1.3.37 || nayateḥ kartā devadattādir lakāravācyaḥ | kartṛsthe karmaṇy aśarīre sati nayater ātmanepadaṃ bhavati | śarīraṃ prāṇikāyaḥ, tadekadeśo ’pi śarīram | krodhaṃ vinayate | manyuṃ vinayate | kartṛsthe iti kim? devadatto yajñadattasya krodhaṃ vinayati | aśarīre iti kim? gaḍuṃ vinayati | ghāṭāṃ vinayati | karmaṇi iti kim? buddhyā vinayati | prajñayā vinayati || dhātor ātmanepadaṃ bhavati | vṛttir apratibandhaḥ | sarga utsāhaḥ | tāyanaṃ sphītatā | vṛttau tāvat — ṛkṣv asya kramate buddhiḥ | na pratihanyate ity arthaḥ | yajuḥṣv asya kramate buddhiḥ | sarge — vyākaraṇādhyayanāya kramate | utsahate ity arthaḥ | tāyane — asmin śāstrāṇi kramante | sphītībhavanti ity arthaḥ | eteṣu iti kim? apakrāmati || vṛttyādiṣv ity eva | upakrāmati | parākrāmati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ āṅa udgamane || 1.3.40 || āṅpūrvāt kramater udgamane bhūt, ākrāmati dhūmo harmyatalāt (MBh I.282) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ veḥ pādaviharaṇe || 1.3.41 || vipūrvāt kramateḥ pādaviharaṇe (DhP I.502) iti, tathāpy anekārthatvād dhātūnām evam uktam | pādaviharaṇe iti kim? vikrāmaty ajinasandhiḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ prakramate bhoktum | upakramate bhoktum | samarthābhyām iti kim? pūrvedyuḥ prakrāmati | gacchati ity arthaḥ | aparedyur upakrāmati | āgacchati ity arthaḥ | atha “upaparābhyām” (1.3.39) ity anenātmanepadam atra kasmān na bhavati? vṛttyādigrahaṇaṃ tatrānuvartate | tato ’nyatredaṃ pratyudāharaṇam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ vicitraṃ bhāṣante ity arthaḥ | upamantraṇaṃ rahasy upacchandanam — kulabhāryām upavadate | paradārān upavadate | upacchandayati ity arthaḥ | eteṣu iti kim? yat kiñ cid vadati || avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpasamṛddhivyṛddhyarthābhāvātyayāsampratiśabdaprādurbhāvapaścādyathānupūrvyayaugapadyasādṛś yasampattisākalyāntavacaneṣu || 2.1.6 || sup supā iti ca vartate / vibhaktyādiṣv artheṣu yad avyayaṃ vartate tat samarthena subantena saha samasyate, avyayībhāvaś ca samāso bhavati / vacanagrahaṇaṃ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate / vibhaktivacane tāvat — strīṣv adhikṛtya kathā pravartate adhistri / adhikumāri / saptamyarthe yad avyayaṃ tad vibhaktivacanam / samīpavacane — kumbhasya samīpam upakumbham / upamaṇikam / samṛddhir ṛddher ādhikyam — samṛddhir madrāṇāṃ sumadram / sumagadhaṃ vartate / vyṛddhir ṛddher abhāvaḥ — gavadikānām ṛddher abhāvaḥ durgavadikam / duryavanaṃ vartate / arthābhāvaḥ vastuno 'bhāvaḥ — abhāvo makṣikāṇāṃ nirmakṣikam / nirmaśakam vartate / atyayaḥ abhūtatvam, atikramaḥ — atītāni himāni atihimam / nirhimam / niḥśītaṃ vartate / asamprati upabhogasya vartamānakālapratiṣedhaḥ — atitaisṛkam / taisṛkam ācchādanam, tasyāyam upabhogakālo na bhavati ity arthaḥ / śabdaprādurbhāvaḥ prakāśatā śabdasya — itipāṇini / tatpāṇini / pāṇiniśabdo loke prakāśate ity arthaḥ / paścāt — anurathaṃ pādātam / rathānāṃ paścāt ity arthaḥ / yathā / yathārthe yad avyayaṃ vartate tat samasyate / yogyatā vīpsā padārthānativṛttiḥ sādṛśyaṃ ca iti yathārthāḥ / yogyatāyām — anurūpam / rūpayogyaṃ bhavati ity arthaḥ / vīpsāyām — artham arthaṃ prati pratyartham / [#102] padārthānativṛttau — yathāśakti / ānupūrvyam anukramaḥ — anujyeṣṭhaṃ praviśantu bhavantaḥ / jyeṣṭhānupūrvyā bhavantaḥ praviśantu ity arthaḥ / yaugapadyam ekakālatā — sacakram dhehi / yugapac cakraṃ dhehi ity arthaḥ / sādṛśyam tulyatā / kimartham idam ucyate, yathārtha ity eva siddham? guṇabhūte 'pi sādṛśye yathā syāt, sadṛśaḥ kikhyā sakikhi / sampattiḥ anurūpātmabhāvaḥ samṛddher anyaḥ — sabrahma bābhravāṇām / sakṣatraṃ śālaṅkāyanānām / sākalyam aśeṣatā — satṛṇam abhyavaharati / sabusam / na kiṃ cid abhyavahāryaṃ parityajati ity ayam artho 'dhikārthavacanena pratipādyate / antavacane — antaḥ iti parigrahāpekṣayā samāptir ucyate / sāgni adhīte / seṣṭi sapaśubandham / sapaśubandhāntam adhīte ity arthaḥ / iyaṃ samāptir asakale 'py adhyayane bhavati iti sākalyāt pṛthag ucyate // narakapatitaḥ / gata — grāmaṃ gataḥ ~ grāmagataḥ / atyasta — taraṅgān atyastaḥ ~ taraṅgātyastaḥ / tuhinātyastaḥ / prāpta — sukhaṃ prāptaḥ ~ sukhaprāptaḥ / āpanna — sukham āpannaḥ ~ 4 sukhāpannaḥ / bhavati / taddhitārthe tāvat — pañcasu kapāleṣu saṃskṛtaḥ pañcakapālaḥ / daśakapālaḥ / “saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ” (4.2.16) itīha aṇ, tasya “dvigor luganapatye” (4.1.88) iti luk / uttarapade — pañcanāvapriyaḥ // ____________________________________________________________________ [#114] pāpāṇake kutsitaiḥ || 2.1.54 || pāpāṇakaśabdau kutsanābhidhāyinau, tayoḥ pūrveṇa samāse paranipātaḥ prāptaḥ, pūrvanipātārtham idam ārabhyate / pāpa aṇaka ity ete subante kutsitavacanaiḥ saha samasyete, tatpuruṣaś ca samāso bhavati / pāpanāpitaḥ / pāpakulālaḥ / aṇakanāpitaḥ / aṇakakulālaḥ // kuñjara / ruru / pṛṣata (pṛṣat) / puṇḍarīka / balāhaka / ākṛtigaṇaś cāyam, tenedam api bhavati — mukhapadmam, mukhakamalam, karakisalayam, pārthivacandraḥ ity evam ādi // samānādhikaraṇena subantena saha bahulaṃ samasyate, tatpuruṣaś ca samāso bhavati / nīlotpalam / raktotpalam / bahulavacanaṃ vyavasthārtham / kva cin nityasamāsa eva, kṛṣṇasarpaḥ, lohitaśāliḥ / kva cin na bhavaty eva, rāmo jāmadagnyaḥ, arjunaḥ kārtavīryaḥ / kva cid vikalpaḥ, nīlam utpalam ~ nīlotpalam / viśeṣaṇam iti kim? takṣakaḥ sarpaḥ / viśeṣyeṇa iti kim? lohitas takṣakaḥ // tadakṛtaṃ ca kṛtākṛtam / bhuktābhuktam / pītāpītam / uditānuditam / nuḍiṭau tadbhaktatvān naiva bhedakau / aśitānaśitena (6.3.74) jīvati / kliṣṭākliśitena (7.2.50) vartate / kṛtāpakṛtādīnām sadādayo vijñāyante / satpuruṣaḥ / mahāpuruṣaḥ / paramapuruṣaḥ / uttamapuruṣaḥ / utkṛṣṭapuruṣaḥ / pūjyamānaiḥ iti kim? utkṛṣṭo gauḥ kardamāt // avayavī, tadvācinā subantena saha pūrva apara adhara uttara ity ete śabdāḥ sāmarthyād ekadeśavacanāḥ samasyante, tatpuruṣaś ca samāso bhavati / ekādhikaraṇagrahaṇam ekadeśino viśeṣaṇam / ekaṃ ced adhikaraṇam ekadravyam ekadeśi bhavati / ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo 'yaṃ yogaḥ / pūrvaṃ kāyasya pūrvakāyaḥ / aparakāyaḥ / adharakāyaḥ / uttarakāyaḥ / ekadeśinā iti kim? pūrvaṃ nābheḥ kāyasya / ekādhikaraṇe iti kim? pūrvaṃ chātrāṇām āmantraya / kathaṃ madhyāhnaḥ, sāyāhnaḥ iti? “saṅkhyāvisāyapūrvasyāhnasyāhann anyatarasyāṃ ṅau” (6.3.110) iti jñāpakāt sarveṇaikadeśaśabdenāhnaḥ samāso bhavati // grahaṇam / ardham ity etad napuṃsakam ekadeśinaikādhikaraṇena samasyate, tatpuruṣaś ca samāso bhavati / ṣaṣṭhīsamāsāpavādo 'yaṃ yogaḥ / ardhaṃ pippalyāḥ ardhapippalī / ardhakośātakī / napuṃsakam iti kim? grāmārdhaḥ / nagarārdhaḥ / ekadeśinā ity eva, ardhaṃ paśor devadattasya / devadattena saha samāso na bhavati / ekādhikaraṇe ity eva, ardhaṃ pippalīnām // anukramiṣyāmaḥ, anabhihite ity evaṃ tad veditavyam / anabhihite anukte, anirdiṣṭe karmādau vibhaktir bhavati / kenānabhihite? tiṅkṛttaddhitasamāsaiḥ parisaṅkhyānam (MBh. 1.440) / vakṣyati, “karmaṇi dvitīyā” (2.3.2) — kaṭaṃ karoti / grāmaṃ gacchati / anabhihite iti kim? tiṅ — kriyate kaṭaḥ / kṛt — kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ / taddhitaḥ — śatyaḥ / śatikaḥ (5.1.21) / samāsaḥ — prāptam udakaṃ yaṃ grāmaṃ prāptodako grāmaḥ / parisaṅkhyānaṃ kim? kaṭaṃ karoti bhīṣmam udāraṃ darśanīyam (MBh. 1.440) / “bahuṣu bahuvacanam” (1.4.21) ity evamādinā saṅkhyā vācyatvena vibhaktīnām upadiṣṭāḥ, tatra viśeṣaṇārtham idam ārabhyate — anabhihitakarmādyāśrayeṣv ekatvādiṣu dvitīyādayo veditavyāḥ (MBh. 1.440) iti // ____________________________________________________________________ karmaṇi dvitīyā || 2.3.2 || dvitīyādayaḥ śabdāḥ pūrvācāryaiḥ supāṃ trikeṣu smaryante, tair evātra vyavahāraḥ / karmaṇi kārake yā saṅkhyā tatra dvitīyā vibhaktir bhavati / kaṭaṃ karoti / grāmaṃ gacchati / ubhasarvatasoḥ kāryā dhiguparyādiṣu triṣu / dvitīyāmreḍitānteṣu tato 'nyatrāpi dṛśyate (MBh. 1.444) // ubhayato grāmam / sarvato grāmam / dhig devadattam / uparyupari grāmam / adhyadhi grāmam / adho 'dho grāmam / abhitaḥparitaḥsamayānikaṣāhāpratiyogeṣu ca dṛśyate (MBh. 1.443) / abhito grāmam / parito grāmam / samayā grāmam / nikaṣā grāmam / hā devadattam / bubhukṣitaṃ na prati bhāti kiñ cit (MBh. 1.443) // viṣaye juhoteḥ karmaṇi kārake tṛtīyā vibhaktir bhavati, dvitīyā ca / “yavāgvāgnihotraṃ juhoti” (Śāṅkhyāyana Śrauta Sūtra 3.12.16) / “yavāgūm agnihotraṃ juhoti” (Śāṅkhyāyana Śrauta Sūtra 3.12.16) / śabdau nipātau sāhacaryād gṛhyete / ābhyāṃ yoge dvitīyā vibhaktir bhavati / ṣaṣṭhyapavādo 'yam yogaḥ / tatrāntarāśabdo madhyamādheyapradhānam ācaṣṭe / antareṇa śabdas tu tac ca vinārthaṃ ca / antarā tvāṃ ca māṃ ca kamaṇḍaluḥ / antareṇa tvāṃ ca māṃ ca kamaṇḍaluḥ (MBh. 1.445) / antareṇa puruṣakāraṃ na kiṃ cil labhyate / yuktagrahaṇaṃ kim? antarā takṣaśilāṃ ca pāṭaliputraṃ srughnasya prākāraḥ // kriyāguṇadravyaiḥ sākalyena kālādhvanoḥ sambandhaḥ atyantasaṃyogaḥ / māsam adhīte / saṃvatsaram adhīte / māsaṃ kalyāṇī / 1 saṃvatsaraṃ kalyāṇī / māsaṃ guḍadhānāḥ / saṃvatsaraṃ guḍadhānāḥ / adhvanaḥ khalv api — krośam adhīte / yojanam adhīte / krośaṃ kuṭilā nadī (MBh. 1.446) / yojanaṃ kuṭilā nadī / krośaṃ parvataḥ / yojanaṃ parvataḥ / atyantasaṃyoge iti kim? māsasya dvir adhīte / krośasyaikadeśe parvataḥ // ____________________________________________________________________ apavarge tṛtīyā || 2.3.6 || kālādhvanor atyantasaṃyoge iti vartate / apavargaḥ phalaprāptau satyāṃ kriyāparisamāptiḥ / apavarge gamyamāne kālādhvanor atyantasaṃyoge tṛtīyā vibhaktir bhavati / māsenānuvāko 'dhītaḥ / saṃvatsareṇānuvāko 'dhītaḥ / adhvanaḥ — krośenānuvāko 'dhītaḥ / yojanenānuvāko 'dhītaḥ / apavarge iti kim? krośam adhīto 'nuvākaḥ / māsam adhītaḥ / kartavyāvṛttau phalasiddher abhāvāt tṛtīyā na bhavati / māsam adhīto 'nuvākaḥ, na cānena gṛhītaḥ (MBh. 1.446) // vibhaktī bhavataḥ / adya bhuktvā devadatto dvyahe bhoktā dvyahād vā bhoktā (MBh. 1.446) / tryahe tryahād vā bhoktā / kartṛśaktyor madhye kālaḥ / iha stho 'yam iṣvāsaḥ krośe lakṣyaṃ vidhyati ~ krośāl lakṣyaṃ vidhyati (MBh. 1.446) / kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kārakayoḥ karmāpādānayoḥ karmādhikaraṇayor vā madhye krośaḥ / saṅkhyātānudeśo na bhavati, asvaritatvāt // saṃhitām anu prāvarṣat / āgastyam anv asiñcat prajāḥ // ____________________________________________________________________ [#134] yasmād adhikaṃ yasya ceśvaravacanaṃ tatra saptamī || 2.3.9 || ceśvaravacanam iti svasvāminor dvayor api paryāyeṇa saptamī vibhaktir bhavati / adhi (1.4.97) brahmadatte pañcālāḥ ~ adhi pañcāleṣu brahmadattaḥ (MBh. 1.447) iti / dvitīyāpavādo yogaḥ // trigartebhyo vṛṣṭo devaḥ / ā (1.4.89) pāṭaliputrād vṛṣṭo devaḥ / pari (1.4.88) trigartebhyo vṛṣto devaḥ / apena sāhacaryāt parer varjanārthasya grahaṇam, teneha na bhavati, vṛkṣaṃ pari (1.4.90) ____________________________________________________________________ gatyarthakarmaṇi dvitīyācaturthyau ceṣṭāyām anadhvani || 2.3.12 || gatyarthānāṃ dhātūnāṃ ceṣṭākriyāṇāṃ parispandakriyāṇāṃ karmaṇi kārake 'dhvavarjite dvitīyācaturthyau bhavataḥ / grāmaṃ gacchati ~ grāmāya gacchati / grāmaṃ vrajati ~ grāmāya vrajati / gatyarthagrahaṇaṃ kim? odanaṃ pacati / karmaṇi iti kim? aśvena vrajati / ceṣṭāyām iti kim? manasā pāṭaliputraṃ gacchati / anadhvani iti kim? adhvānaṃ gacchati / adhvanīty arthagrahaṇam (MBh. 1.448) / panthānaṃ gacchati / mārgaṃ gacchati / āsthitapratiṣedhaś cāyaṃ vijñeyaḥ (MBh. 1.448) / āsthitaḥ samprāptaḥ, ākrānta ucyate / yatra tu utpathena 2 panthānaṃ gacchati, tatra bhavitavyam eva caturthyā, pathe gacchati iti (MBh. 1.448) / dvitīyāgrahaṇaṃ kim? na caturthy eva vikalpyeta, apavādaviṣaye 'pi yathā syāt / grāmaṃ gantā / grāmāya gantā / kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī na bhavati // ____________________________________________________________________ [#135] caturthī sampradāne || 2.3.13 || sampradāne kārake caturthī vibhaktir bhavati / upadhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti / mānavakāya bhikṣāṃ dadāti / devadattāya rocate / puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati ity ādi / caturthīvidhāne tādarthya upasaṅkhyānam (MBh. 1.449) / yūpāya dāru / kuṇḍalāya hiraṇyam / randhanāya sthālī / avahananāyolūkhalam / kḷpi sampadyamāne caturthī vaktavyā (MBh. 1.449) / mūtrāya kalpate yavāgūḥ / uccārāya kalpate yavāgūḥ / kḷpi ity arthanirdeśaḥ / mūtrāya sampadyate yavāgūḥ / mūtrāya jāyate yavagūḥ / utpātena jñāpyamāne caturthī vaktavyā (MBh. 1.449) / vātāya kapilā vidyud | ātapāyātilohinī / pītā varṣāya vijñeyā | durbhikṣāya sitā bhavet (MBh. 1.449) // hitayoge caturthī vaktavyā (MBh. 1.450) / gobhyo hitam / arocakine hitam // puṣpebhyo vrajati / kriyārthopapadasya iti kim? praviśa piṇḍīm / praviśa tarpaṇam / bhakṣir atra sthānī, na tu kriyārthopapadaḥ / karmaṇi iti kim? edhebhyo vrajati śakaṭena / sthāninaḥ iti kim? edhān āhartuṃ vrajati // ____________________________________________________________________ tumarthāc ca bhāvavacanāt || 2.3.15 || tumunā samānārthas tumarthaḥ / tumarthabhāvavacanapratyayāntāt prātipadikāc caturthī vibhaktir bhavati / “bhāvavacanāś ca” (3.3.11) iti vakṣyati, tasyedaṃ grahaṇam / pākāya vrajati / tyāgāya vrajati / bhūtaye vrajati / saṃpattaye vrajati / tumarthāt iti kim? nimittaṃ vasati ~ kena nimittena vasati ~ kasmai nimittāya vasati ~ kasmān nimittād vasati ~ kasya nimittasya vasati ~ kasmin nimitte vasati / evaṃ kāraṇahetvor apy udāhāryam / arthagrahaṇaṃ caitat / paryāyopādānaṃ tu svarūpavidhir mā vijñāyi iti / tenehāpi bhavati — kiṃ prayojanaṃ vasati ~ kena prayojanena vasati ~ kasmai prayojanāya vasati ~ kasmāt prayojanād vasati ~ kasya prayojanasya vasati ~ 1.455) / gavīdhumataḥ sāṅkāśyaṃ catvāri yojanāni ~ caturṣu yojaneṣu vā // ____________________________________________________________________ anyārāditarartedikśabdāñcūttarapadājāhiyukte || 2.3.29 || anya ārāt itara ṛte dikśabda añcūttarapada āc āhi ity etair yoge pañcamī vibhaktir bhavati / anya ity arthagrahaṇam / tena paryāyaprayoge 'pi bhavati / anyo devadattāt / bhinno devadattāt / arthāntaraṃ devadattāt / [#140] vilakṣaṇo devadattāt / ārācchabdo dūrāntikārthe vartate / tatra “dūrāntikārthaiḥ ṣaṣthy anyatarasyām” (2.3.34) / iti prāpte pañcamī vidhīyate / ārād devadattāt / ārād pūrvo grīṣmād vasantaḥ / uttaro grīṣmo vasantāt / +dikśabda (Sharma: dvikśabda) ity atra śabdagrahaṇaṃ deśakālavṛttināpi dikśabdena yoge yathā syāt, itarathā hi digvṛttinaiva syāt, iyam asyāḥ pūrvā iti / iha tu na syāt, ayam asmāt pūrvaḥ kālaḥ iti / añcūttarapada — prāg grāmāt / pratyag grāmāt (MBh. 1.456) / nanu cāyam api dikśabda eva / “ṣaṣṭhy atasarthapratyayena” (2.3.30) iti vakṣyati, devadattāt / pṛthagvinānānābhiḥ iti yogavibhāgo dvitīyārthaḥ / vinā vātaṃ vinā varṣaṃ | vidyutprapatanaṃ vinā / vinā hastikṛtān doṣān | kenemau pātitau drumau // ajā devadattena // ____________________________________________________________________ tulyārthair atulopamābhyāṃ tṛtīyānyatarasyām || 2.3.72 || tulyārthaiḥ śabdair yoge tṛtīyā vibhaktir bhavaty anyatarasyām, pakṣe ṣaṣṭhī ca, tulopamāśabdau varjayitvā / śeṣe viṣaye tṛtīyāvidhānāt tayā mukte ṣaṣṭhy eva bhavati / tulyo devadattena ~ tulyo devadattasya / sadṛśo devadattena ~ sadṛśo devadattasya / atulopamābhyām iti kim? tulā devadattasya nāsti / upamā kṛṣṇasya na vidyate / vā iti vartamāne 'nyatarasyāṃ grahaṇam uttarasūtre tasya cakāreṇānukarṣaṇārtham / itarathā hi tṛtīyānukṛṣyeta // ity etair yoge caturthī vibhaktir bhavati / cakāro vikalpānukarṣaṇārthaḥ / śeṣe caturthīvidhānāt tayā mukte ṣaṣṭhī vibhaktir bhavati / atrāyuṣyādīnāṃ paryāyagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam / āyuṣyaṃ devadattāya bhūyāt ~ āyuṣyaṃ devadattasya bhūyāt / ciraṃ jīvitaṃ devadattāya devadattasya vā bhuyāt / [#152] madraṃ devadattāya devadattasya vā bhūyāt / bhadraṃ devadattāya ~ bhadraṃ devadattasya / kuśalaṃ devadattāya ~ kuśalaṃ devadattasya / nirāmayaṃ devadattāya ~ nirāmayaṃ devadattasya / sukhaṃ devadattāya ~ sukhaṃ devadattasya / śaṃ devadattāya ~ śaṃ devadattasya / artho 11 devadattāya ~ artho devadattasya / prayojanaṃ devadattāya ~ prayojanaṃ devadattasya / hitaṃ devadattāya ~ hitaṃ devadattasya / pathyaṃ devadattāya ~ pathyaṃ devadattasya / āśiṣi iti kim? āyuṣyaṃ devadattasya tapaḥ // iti (1969) have been corrected and are indicated with a superscript plus sign + [p. 153] dvitīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ dvigur ekavacanam || 2.4.1 || dviguḥ samāsaḥ ekavacanaṃ bhavati | ekasya vacanam ekavacanam | ekasyārthasya vācako bhavati ity arthaḥ | tad anena prakāreṇa dvigvarthasyaikavadbhāvo vidhīyate, dvigvartha ekavad bhavati iti | samāhāradvigoś cedaṃ grahaṇam, nānyasya | pañca pūlāḥ samāhṛtāḥ pañcapūlī | daśapūlī | dvigvarthasyaikatvād anuprayoge 'py ekavacanaṃ bhavati, pañcapūlīyaṃ śobhanā iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ dvandvaś ca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām || 2.4.2 || ekavacanam iti vartate | aṅgaśabdasya pratyekaṃ vākyaparisamāptyā trīṇi vākyāni sampadyante | prāṇyaṅgānāṃ dvandva ekavad bhavati, tathā tūryāṅgānāṃ senāṅgānāṃ ca | prāṇyaṅgānāṃ tāvat — pāṇipādam | śirogrīvam | tūryāṅgānām — mārdaṅgikapāṇavikam | vīṇāvādakaparivādakam | senāṅgānām — rathikāśvāroham | rathikapādātam | hastyaśvādiṣu paratvāt paśudvandve vibhāṣayā ekavad (2.4.12) bhavati | itaretarayoge samāhāre ca dvandvo vihitaḥ | tatra samāhārasyaikatvāt siddham evaikavacanam | idaṃ tu prakaraṇaṃ viṣayavibhāgārtham, prāṇyaṅgādīnāṃ samāhāra eva dvandvaḥ, dadhipayādīnām itaretarayoga eva (2.4.14), vṛkṣamṛgādīnām (2.4.12) ubhayatra iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ anuvāde caraṇānām || 2.4.3 || caraṇaśabdaḥ śākhānimittakaḥ puruṣeṣu vartate | caraṇānāṃ dvandvaḥ ekavad bhavati anuvāde gamyamāne | pramāṇāntarāvagatasyārthasya śabdena saṅkīrtanamātram anuvādaḥ | udagād kaṭhakālāpam | pratyaṣṭhāt kaṭhakauthumam (MBh. 1.474) | kaṭhakālāpādīnām udayapratiṣṭhe pramāṇāntarāvagate yadā punaḥ śabdenānūdyete tadaivam udāharaṇam | yadā tu prathamata evopadeśas tadā pratyudāharaṇam | anuvāde iti kim? udaguḥ kaṭhakālāpāḥ | pratyaṣṭhuḥ kaṭhakauthumāḥ | stheṇor adyatanyāṃ ceti vaktavyam (MBh. 1.474) | stheṇoḥ iti kim? anandiṣuḥ kaṭhakālāpāḥ | adyatanyām iti kim? udyanti kaṭhakālāpāḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ adhvaryukratur anapuṃsakam || 2.4.4 || adhvaryuvede yasya krator vidhānaṃ so 'dhvaryukratuḥ | adhvaryukratuvācināṃ śabdānām anapuṃsakaliṅgānāṃ dvandvaḥ ekavad bhavati | adhvaryukratur anapuṃsakaṃ dvandvaḥ iti gauṇo nirdeśaḥ | arkāśvamedham | sāyāhnātirātram | adhvaryukratuḥ iti kim? iṣuvajrau | udbhidbalabhidau | anapuṃsakam iti kim? rājasūyavājapeye | iha kasmān na bhavati, darśapaurṇamāsau? kratuśabdaḥ somayāgeṣu rūḍhaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 154] adhyayanato 'viprakṛṣṭākhyānām || 2.4.5 || adhyayanena nimittena yeṣām aviprakṛṣṭā pratyāsannā ākhyā, teṣāṃ dvandvaḥ ekavad bhavati | padakakramakam | kramakavārtikam | sampāṭhaḥ padānāṃ kramasya ca pratyāsannaḥ | adhyayanataḥ iti kim? pitāputrau | aviprakṛṣṭākhyānām iti kim? yājñikavaiyākaraṇau || 1 ___________________________________________________________________________________________ jātir aprāṇinām || 2.4.6 || jātivācināṃ śabdānāṃ dvandva ekavad bhavati prāṇino varjayitvā | ārāśastri | dhānāśaṣkuli | jātiḥ iti kim? nandakapāñcajanyau | aprāṇinām iti kim? brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāḥ | nañivayuktanyāyena (Vyā. pa. 65) dravyajātīnām ayam ekavadbhāvaḥ, na guṇakriyājātīnām | rūparasagandhasparśāḥ | gamanākuñcanaprasāraṇāni | jātiparatve ca jātiśabdānām ayam ekavadbhāvo vidhīyate, na niyatadravyavivakṣāyām — iha kuṇḍe badarāmalakāni tiṣṭhanti iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ viśiṣṭaliṅgo nadī deśo 'grāmāḥ || 2.4.7 || viśiṣṭaliṅgānāṃ bhinnaliṅgānāṃ nadīvācināṃ śabdānāṃ deśavācināṃ ca grāmavarjitānāṃ dvandva ekavad bhavati | nadyavayavo dvandvo nadī ity ucyate | deśāvayavaś ca deśaḥ | nadī deśaḥ ity asamāsanirdeśa evāyam | uddhyaś ca irāvatī ca uddhyerāvati | gaṅgāśoṇam | deśaḥ khalv api — kuravaś ca kurukṣetraṃ ca kurukurukṣetram | kurukurujāṅgalam | viśiṣṭaliṅgaḥ iti kim? gaṅgāyamune | madrakekayāḥ | nadī deśaḥ iti kim? kukkuṭamayūryau | agrāmāḥ iti kim? jāmbavaś ca śālūkinī ca jāmbavaśālūkinyau | nadīgrahaṇam adeśatvāt | janapado hi deśaḥ | tathā ca parvatānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na bhavati, kailāsaś ca gandhamādanaṃ ca kailāsagandhamādane | agrāmā ity atra nagarāṇāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ (MBh. 1.474) | iha mā bhūt, mathurā ca pāṭaliputraṃ ca mathurāpāṭaliputram | ubhayataś ca grāmāṇāṃ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ (MBh. 1.474) | sauryaṃ ca nagaraṃ, ketavataṃ ca grāmaḥ sauryaketavate || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 155] kṣudrajantavaḥ || 2.4.8 || apacitaparimāṇaḥ kṣudraḥ | kṣudrajantuvācināṃ dvandvaḥ ekavad bhavati | daṃśamaśakam | yūkālikṣam | kṣudrajantavaḥ iti kim? brāhmaṇakṣatriyau | kṣudrajantur anasthiḥ syād | atha vā kṣudra eva yaḥ | śataṃ vā prasṛtau yeṣāṃ | ke cid ā nakulād api || ā nakulād api iti iyam eva smṛtiḥ pramāṇam, itarāsāṃ tadvirodhāt || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ yeṣāṃ ca virodhaḥ śāśvatikaḥ || 2.4.9 || virodho vairam | śāśvatiko nityaḥ | yeṣāṃ śāśvatiko virodhaḥ tadvācināṃ śabdānāṃ dvandva ekavad bhavati | mārjāramūṣakaṃ | ahinakulam | śāśvatikaḥ iti kim? gaupāliśālaṅkāyanāḥ kalahāyante | cakāraḥ punar asyaiva samuccayārthaḥ | tena paśuśakunidvandve virodhinām anena nityam ekavadbhāvo bhavati — aśvamahiṣam | śvaśṛgālam | kākolūkam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ śūdrāṇām aniravasitānām || 2.4.10 || niravasānaṃ bahiṣkaraṇam | kuto bahiṣkaraṇam? pātrāt | yair bhukte pātraṃ saṃskāreṇāpi na śudhyati te niravasitāḥ (MBh. 1.475) | na niravasitāḥ aniravasitāḥ | aniravasitaśūdravācināṃ śabdānāṃ dvandva ekavad bhavati | takṣāyaskāram | rajakatantuvāyam | aniravasitānām iti kim? caṇḍālamṛtapāḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca || 2.4.11 || gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca kṛtaikavadbhāvāni dvandvarūpāṇi sādhūni bhavanti | gavāśvam | gavāvikam | gavaiḍakam | ajāvikam | ajaiḍakam | kubjavāmanam | kubjakairātakam | putrapautram | śvacaṇḍālam | strīkumāram | dāsīmāṇavakam | śāṭīpicchakam | uṣṭrakharam | uṣṭraśaśam | mūtraśakṛt | mūtrapurīṣam | yakṛnmedaḥ | māṃsaśoṇitam | darbhaśaram | darbhapūtīkam | arjunaśirīṣam | tṛṇolapam | dāsīdāsam | kuṭīkuṭam | bhāgavatībhāgavatam | gavāśvaprabhṛtiṣu yathoccāritaṃ dvandvavṛttam | rūpāntare tu nāyaṃ vidhir bhavati | go'śvam, go'śvau | paśudvandvavibhāṣaiva bhavati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 156] vibhāṣā vṛkṣamṛgatṛṇadhānyavyañjanapaśuśakunyaśvavaḍavapūrvāparādharottarāṇām || 2.4.12 || 2 vṛkṣa mṛga tṛṇa dhānya vyañjana paśu śakuni aśvavaḍava pūrvāpara adharottara ity eteṣām dvandvo vibhāṣā ekavad bhavati | plakṣanyagrodham ~ plakṣanyagrodhāḥ | rurupṛṣatam ~ rurupṛṣatāḥ | kuśakāśam ~ kuśakāśāḥ | vrīhiyavam ~ vrīhiyavāḥ | dadhighṛtam ~ dadhighṛte | gomahiṣam ~ gomahiṣāḥ | tittirikapiñjalam ~ tittirikapiñjalāḥ | aśvavaḍavam ~ aśvavaḍavau | pūrvāparam ~ pūrvāpare | adharottaram ~ adharottare | bahuprakṛtiḥ phalasenāvanaspatimṛgaśakunikṣudrajantudhānyatṛṇānām (MBh. 1.475) | eṣāṃ bahuprakṛtir eva dvandva ekavad bhavati, na dviprakṛtiḥ | badarāmalake | rathikāśvārohau | plakṣanyagrodhau | rurupṛṣatau | haṃsacakravākau | yūkālikṣe | vrīhiyavau | kuśakāśau || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ vipratiṣiddhaṃ cānadhikaraṇavāci || 2.4.13 || parasparaviruddhaṃ vipratiṣiddham | vipratiṣiddhārthānāṃ śabdānām anadhikaraṇavācinām adravyavācināṃ dvandva ekavad bhavati | vibhāṣānukarṣaṇārthaś cakāraḥ | śītoṣṇam ~ śītoṣṇe | sukhaduḥkham ~ sukhaduḥkhe | jīvitamaraṇam ~ jīvitamaraṇe | vipratiṣiddham iti kim? kāmakrodhau | anadhikaraṇavāci iti kim? śītoṣṇe udake || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ na dadhipayaādīni || 2.4.14 || yathāyatham ekavadbhāve prāpte pratiṣedha ārabhyate | dadhipayaādīni śabdarūpāṇi naikavad bhavanti | dadhipayasī | sarpirmadhunī | madhusarpiṣī | brahmaprajāpatī | śivavaiśravaṇau | skandaviśākhau | parivrāṭkauśikau | pravargyopasadau | śauklakṛṣṇau | idhmābarhiṣī | nipātanād dīrghaḥ | dīkṣātapasī | śraddhātapasī | medhātapasī | adhyayanatapasī | ulūkhalamusale | ādyāvasāne | śraddhāmedhe | ṛksāme | vāṅmanase || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ adhikaraṇaitāvattve ca || 2.4.15 || na iti vartate | adhikaraṇaṃ vartipadārthaḥ | sa hi samāsasyārthasyādhāraḥ | tasyaitāvattve parimāṇe gamyamāne dvandvo naikavad bhavati | yathāyatham ekavadbhāvaḥ prāptaḥ pratiṣidhyate | daśa dantoṣṭhāḥ | daśa mārdaṅgikapāṇavikāḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 157] vibhāṣā samīpe || 2.4.16 || adhikaraṇaitāvattvasya samīpe vibhāṣā +dvandva (Sharma: dvandvaḥ) ekavad bhavati | upadaśaṃ dantoṣṭham ~ upadaśāḥ dantoṣṭhāḥ | upadaśaṃ mārdaṅgikapāṇavikam ~ upadaśā mārdaṅgikapāṇavikāḥ | avyayasya saṅkhyayāvyayībhāvo 'pi vihitaḥ (2.1.6), bahuvrīhir api (2.2.25) | tatraikavadbhāvapakṣe 'vyayībhāvo 'nuprayujyate, itaratra bahuvrīhiḥ (MBh. 1.477) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ sa napuṃsakam || 2.4.17 || yasyāyam ekavadbhāvo vihitaḥ sa napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati dvigur dvandvaś ca | pañcagavam | daśagavam | dvandvaḥ khalv api — pāṇipādam | śirogrīvam | +paravalliṅgatāpavādo (Sharma: paraliṅgatāpavādo; see manuscript variants) yogaḥ | akārāntottarapado dviguḥ striyāṃ bhāṣyate | pañcapūlī | daśarathī | vābantaḥ striyām iṣṭaḥ | pañcakhaṭvam ~ pañcakhaṭvī | ano nalopaś ca vā ca dviguḥ striyām | pañcatakṣam ~ pañcatakṣī | pātrādibhyaḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ | pañcapātram | caturyugam | tribhuvanam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ avyayībhāvaś ca || 2.4.18 || avyayībhāvaś ca samāso napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati | adhistri | upakumāri | unmattagaṅgam | lohitagaṅgam | pūrvapadārthapradhānasyāliṅgataiva prāptā, anyapadārthapradhānasyābhidheyavalliṅgatā, ata idam ucyate | anuktasamuccayārthaś cakāraḥ | [p. 158] puṇyasudinābhyām ahnaḥ klībateṣyate | puṇyāham | sudināham | pathaḥ saṅkhyāvyayādeḥ klībateṣyate | tripatham | catuṣpatham | vipatham | supatham | kriyāviśeṣaṇānāṃ ca klībateṣyate | mṛdu pacati | śobhanaṃ pacati | ca varjayitvānyas tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati ity etad adhikṛtaṃ veditavyam, yad ita ūrdhvam anukramiṣyāmas | tatra vakṣyati — “vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām” (2.4.25) iti | brāhmaṇasenam ~ brāhmaṇasenā | tatpuruṣaḥ iti kim? dṛḍhaseno rājā | anañ iti kim? asenā | akarmadhārayaḥ iti kim? paramasenā (MBh. 1.478) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ sañjñāyāṃ kanthośīnareṣu || 2.4.20 || sañjñāyāṃ viṣaye kanthāntas tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati, sā cet kanthā uśīnareṣu bhavati | sauśamikantham | āhvarakantham | sañjñāyām iti kim? vīraṇakanthā | uśīnareṣu iti kim? dākṣikanthā | paravalliṅgatāpavāda idaṃ prakaraṇam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ upajñopakramaṃ tadādyācikhyāsāyām || 2.4.21 || upajñāyate ity upajñā | upakramyate ity upakramaḥ | upajñā ca upakramaś ca upajñopakramam | tadantas tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati tadādyācikhyāsāyām, tayor upajñopakramayor āder ācikhyāsāyāṃ gamyamānāyām | ākhyātum icchā ācikhyāsā | yady upajñeyasyopakramyasya cārthasyādir ākhyātum iṣyate tata etad bhavati | pāṇinyupajñam akālakaṃ vyākaraṇam | pāṇiner upajñānena prathamataḥ praṇītam akālakaṃ vyākaraṇam | vyāḍyupajñaṃ +duṣkaraṇam (Sharma: daśahuṣkaraṇam) | +āḍhyopakramaṃ (Sharma: ādyopakramaṃ) prāsādaḥ | nandopakramāṇi mānāni | darśanīyopakramaṃ sukumāram | upajñopakramam iti kim? vālmīkiślokāḥ | tadādyācikhyāsāyām iti kim? devadattopajño rathaḥ | yajñadattopakramo rathaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 159] chāyā bāhulye || 2.4.22 || “vibhāṣā senāsurācchāyāśālāniśānām” (2.4.25) iti vibhāṣāṃ vakṣyati | nityārtham idaṃ vacanam | chāyāntas tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati bāhulye gamyamāne | pūrvapadārthadharmaḥ bāhulyam | śalabhādīnāṃ hi bahutvaṃ gamyate | śalabhacchāyam | ikṣucchāyam | bāhulye iti kim? kuḍyacchāyā || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ sabhā rājāmanuṣyapūrvā || 2.4.23 || sabhāntas tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati, sā cet sabhā rājapūrvā, amanuṣyapūrvā ca bhavati | inasabham | īśvarasabham | iha kasmān na bhavati, rājasabhā? paryāyavacanasyaiveṣyate | tad uktam — “jitparyāyasyaiva rājādyartham” (Vā. 10) iti | amanuṣyapūrvā — rakṣaḥsabham | piśācasabham | iha kasmān na bhavati, kāṣṭhasabhā? amanuṣyaśabdo rūḍhirūpeṇa rakṣaḥpiśācādiṣv eva vartate | rājāmanuṣyapūrvā iti kim? devadattasabhā || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ aśālā ca || 2.4.24 || aśālā ca yā sabhā tadantas tatpuruṣo napuṃsakaliṅgo bhavati | saṅghātavacano 'tra sabhāśabdo gṛhyate | strīsabham | dāsīsabham | dāsīsaṅghātaḥ ity arthaḥ | aśālā iti kim? anāthasabhā | anāthakuṭī ity arthaḥ || bhavato 'nākāṅkṣe vācye | yatra pūrvottare kriye staḥ, tac ced vākyaṃ na paraṃ kiñ cid ākāṅkṣate iti | ṇamulanantaraḥ, ktvā tu pūrvasūtravihito 'pi pratiṣidhyate | yad ayaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ pacati (better: paṭhati; see mss. in Sharma) | yad ayam adhīte tataḥ śete | anākāṅkṣe iti kim? yad ayaṃ bhuktvā vrajati adhīte eva tataḥ param || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 298] vibhāṣā 'greprathamapūrveṣu || 3.4.24 || aprāptavibhāṣeyam | ābhīkṣṇye iti nānuvartate | agre prathama pūrva ity eteṣūpapadeṣu samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle dhātoḥ ktvāṇamulau pratyayau vibhāṣā bhavataḥ | agre bhojaṃ vrajati ~ agre bhuktvā vrajati | prathamaṃ bhojaṃ vrajati ~ prathamaṃ bhuktvā vrajati | pūrvaṃ bhojaṃ vrajati ~ pūrvaṃ bhuktvā vrajati | vibhāṣāgrahaṇam etābhyāṃ mukte laḍādayo 'pi yathā syuḥ | agre bhuṅkte tato vrajati | nanu ca vāsarūpa iti bhaviṣyati? ktvāṇamulau yatra saha vidhīyete tatra vāsarūpavidhir nāsti ity etad anena jñāpyate, tena ābhīkṣṇye laḍādayo na bhavanti | upapadasamāsaḥ kasmān na kriyate? uktaṃ tatraivakārasya prayojanam, “amaiva” (2.2.20) yat tulyavidhānam upapadaṃ tat samasyate, nānyat iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ karmaṇy ākrośe kṛñaḥ khamuñ || 3.4.25 || karmaṇy upapade kṛño dhātoḥ khamuñ pratyayo bhavati ākrośe gamyamāne | coraṃkāram ākrośati | coro 'si, dasyur asi ity ākrośati | corakaraṇam ākrośasampādanārtham eva, na tv asau coraḥ kriyate || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ svādumi ṇamul || 3.4.26 || samānakartṛkayoḥ pūrvakāle kṛñaḥ iti cānuvartate | svādumi ity arthagrahaṇam | svādvartheṣūpapadeṣu kṛño ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte | sampannaṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte | lavaṇaṅkāram | svādumi iti makārāntanipātanam īkārābhāvārtham, cvyantasyāpi makārārthaṃ dīrghābhāvārthaṃ ca (MBh. 2.347) | asvādvīṃ svādvīṃ kṛtvā +yavāgūṃ (see mss. in Sharma) bhuṅkte = svāduṅkāraṃ ?(yavāgūṃ—see the MBh.) bhuṅkte | 5 vāsarūpeṇa ktvā api bhavati, svāduṃ kṛtvā bhuṅkte | tumarthādhikārāc ca sarva ete bhāve pratyayāḥ | yady evam, svāduṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte devadattaḥ (MBh. 2.348) iti ṇamulā kartur anabhihitatvāt kartari kasmāt tṛtīyā na bhavati? bhujipratyayenābhihitaḥ kartā, na cāsmin prakaraṇe śaktiśaktimator bhedo vivakṣyate, samānakartṛkatvaṃ hi virudhyate | pradhānaśaktyabhidhāne vā guṇaśaktir abhihitavat prakāśate || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ anyathaivaṃkathamitthaṃsu siddhāprayogaś cet || 3.4.27 || kṛñaḥ ity eva | anyathādiṣūpapadeṣu kṛño ṇamul pratyayo bhavati, siddhāprayogaś cet karoter bhavati | kathaṃ punar asau siddhāprayogaḥ? nirarthakatvān na prayogam arhati iti evam eva prayujyate | anyathā bhuṅkte iti yāvān arthas tāvān eva anyathākāraṃ bhuṅkte iti gamyate | anyathākāraṃ bhuṅkte | evaṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte | kathaṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte | itthaṅkāraṃ bhuṅkte | siddhāprayogaḥ iti kim? anyathā kṛtvā śiro bhuṅkte || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 299] yathātathayor asūyāprativacane || 3.4.28 || kṛñaḥ siddhāprayoge iti vartate | yathātathāśabdayor upapadayoḥ kṛño ṇamul pratyayo bhavati asūyāprativacane gamyamāne | yady asūyan pṛcchati prativakti tatra prativacanam, yathākāram ahaṃ bhokṣye, tathākāram ahaṃ, kiṃ tavānena? | asūyāprativacane iti kim? yathā kṛtvāhaṃ bhokṣye, tathā tvaṃ drakṣyasi | siddhāprayoge ity eva, yathā kṛtvāhaṃ śiro bhokṣye, kiṃ tavānena? || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ karmaṇi dṛśividoḥ sākalye || 3.4.29 || karmaṇy upapade sākalyaviśiṣte 'rthe dṛśividoḥ dhātvoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | kanyādarśaṃ varayati | yāḥ yāḥ kanyāḥ paśyati tās tāḥ varayati ity arthaḥ | brāhmaṇavedaṃ bhojayati | yaṃ yaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jānāti labhate vicārayati vā tān sarvān bhojayati ity arthaḥ | sākalye iti kim? brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhojayati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ yāvati vindajīvoḥ || 3.4.30 || yāvacchabda upapade vindater jīvateś ca ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | yāvadvedaṃ bhuṅkte | yāval labhate tāvad bhuṅkte ity arthaḥ | yāvajjīvam adhīte | yāvaj jīvati tāvad adhīte ity arthaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ carmodarayoḥ pūreḥ || 3.4.31 || karmaṇi ity eva | carmodarayoḥ karmaṇor upapadayoḥ pūrayateḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | carmapūraṃ stṛṇāti | udarapūraṃ bhuṅkte || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ varṣapramāṇa ūlopaś cāsyānyatarasyām || 3.4.32 || karmaṇi ity eva | pūrayateḥ dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati, ūlopaś cāsya pūrayater anyatarasyāṃ bhavati, samudāyena ced varṣasya pramāṇam iyattā gamyate | goṣpadapūraṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ ~ goṣpadapraṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ | sītāpūraṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ ~ sītāpraṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ | asyagrahaṇaṃ kimartham | upapadasya mā bhūt | mūṣikābilapūraṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ ~ mūṣikābilapram || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ cele knopeḥ || 3.4.33 || 6 karmaṇi ity eva | “knūyī śabde undane ca” (Dhp. 1.514 [Sharma: 485]), asmāṇ ṇyantād dhātoḥ celārtheṣu karmasu upapadeṣu ṇamul pratyayo bhavati, varṣapramāṇe gamyamāne | celaknopaṃ vṛṣṭo devaḥ | vastraknopam | vasanaknopam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 300] nimūlasamūlayoḥ kaṣaḥ || 3.4.34 || karmaṇi ity eva | nimūlasamūlaśabdayoḥ karmavācinor upapadayoḥ kaṣeḥ dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | nimūlakāṣaṃ kaṣati | samūlakāṣaṃ kaṣati | nimūlaṃ samūlaṃ kaṣati ity arthaḥ | itaḥ prabhṛti kaṣādīn yān vakṣyati tatra “kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhy anuprayogaḥ” (3.4.46) iti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ śuṣkacūrṇarūkṣeṣu piṣaḥ || 3.4.35 || karmaṇi ity eva | śuṣkādiṣu karmavāciṣu upapadeṣu piṣer dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | śuṣkapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | śuṣkaṃ pinaṣṭi ity arthaḥ | cūrṇapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | cūrṇaṃ pinaṣṭi ity arthaḥ | rūkṣapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | rūkṣaṃ pinaṣṭi ity arthaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ samūlākṛtajīveṣu han-kṛñ-grahaḥ || 3.4.36 || karmaṇi ity eva | samūla akṛta jīva ity eteṣu śabdeṣu karmasu upapadeṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ han kṛñ graha ity etebhyo dhātubhyo ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | samūlaghātaṃ hanti | samūlaṃ hanti ity arthaḥ | akṛtakāraṃ karoti | jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhṇāti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ karaṇe hanaḥ || 3.4.37 || karaṇe upapade hanter dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | pāṇighātaṃ vediṃ hanti | pādaghātaṃ bhūmiṃ hanti | “hiṃsārthānāṃ ca samānakarmakāṇām” (3.4.48) iti ṇamulaṃ vakṣyati | ahiṃsārtho 'yam ārambhaḥ | nityasamāsārtho vā yathāvidhyanuprayogārthaś ca | pūrvavipratiṣedhena hanteḥ hiṃsārthasyāpi pratyayo 'nenaiveṣyate | asighātaṃ hanti | śaraghātaṃ hanti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ snehane piṣaḥ || 3.4.38 || karaṇe ity eva | snihyate yena tat snehanam | snehanavācini karaṇe upapade piṣer dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | udapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | tailapeṣaṃ pinaṣṭi | tailena pinaṣṭi ity arthaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 301] haste vartigrahoḥ || 3.4.39 || karaṇe ity eva | haste ity arthagrahaṇam | vartiḥ ṇyantaḥ | hastavācini karaṇe upapade vartayateḥ gṛhṇāteś ca ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | hastena vartayati = hastavartaṃ vartayati | karavartam | pāṇivartam | graheḥ khalv api — hastena gṛhṇāti = hastagrāhaṃ gṛhṇāti | karagrāham | pāṇigrāham || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ sve puṣaḥ || 3.4.40 || karaṇe ity eva | sve ity arthagrahaṇam | svavācini karaṇe upapade puṣer dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | ātmīyajñātidhanavacanaḥ svaśabdaḥ | svapoṣaṃ puṣṇāti | ātmapoṣam | gopoṣam | pitṛpoṣam | mātṛpoṣam | dhanapoṣam | raipoṣam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ 7 adhikaraṇe bandhaḥ || 3.4.41 || adhikaraṇavācini upapade badhnāteḥ dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | cakrabandhaṃ badhnāti | kūṭabandhaṃ badhnāti | muṣṭibandhaṃ badhnāti | corakabandhaṃ badhnāti | corake badhnāti ity arthaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ sañjñāyām || 3.4.42 || sañjñāyāṃ viṣaye badhnāteḥ dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | krauñcabandhaṃ badhnāti | mayūrikābandhaṃ badhnāti | mayūrikābandhaṃ baddhaḥ | aṭṭālikābandhaṃ baddhaḥ | bandhaviśeṣāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni etāni || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ kartor jīvapuruṣayor naśivahoḥ || 3.4.43 || jīvapuruṣayoḥ kartṛvācinor upapadayoḥ yathāsaṅkhyaṃ naśivahoḥ dhātvoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | jīvanāśaṃ naśyati | jīvo naśyati ity arthaḥ | puruṣavāhaṃ vahati | puruṣaḥ preṣyo bhūtvā vahati ity arthaḥ | kartari iti kim? jīvena naṣṭaḥ | puruṣeṇoḍhaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ ūrdhve śuṣipūroḥ || 3.4.44 || kartṛgrahaṇam anuvartate | ūrdhvaśabde kartṛvācini upapade śuṣipūroḥ (Sharma’s śuṣipuroḥ is a misprint) dhātvoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | ūrdhvaśoṣaṃ śuṣyati | ūrdhvaṃ śuṣyati ity arthaḥ | ūrdhvapūraṃ pūryate | ūrdhvaṃ pūryate ity arthaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 302] upamāne karmaṇi ca || 3.4.45 || upamīyate 'nena ity upamānam | upamāne karmaṇi upapade, cakārāt kartari, dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | ghṛtanidhāyaṃ nihitaḥ | ghṛtam iva nihitaḥ ity arthaḥ | suvarṇanidhāyaṃ nihitaḥ | suvarṇam iva nihitaḥ ity arthaḥ | kartari khalv api — ajakanāśaṃ naṣṭaḥ | ajaka iva naṣṭaḥ | cūḍakanāśam | dantanāśam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhy anuprayogaḥ || 3.4.46 || nimūlasamūlayoḥ (3.4.34) ity etad ārabhya kaṣādayaḥ | eteṣu yathāvidhy anuprayogo bhavati | yasmād dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati sa eva anuprayoktavyaḥ | nanu dhātusambandhe pratyayavidhānād anuprayogaḥ siddha eva? yathāvidhi iti niyamārthaṃ vacanam, tathā caivodāhṛtam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ upadaṃśas tṛtīyāyām || 3.4.47 || “daṃśa daśane” (Dhp. 1.1038 [Sharma: 990]), asmād dhātor upapūrvāt tṛtīyānte upapade ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | mūlakopadaṃśaṃ bhuṅkte ~ mūlakenopadaṃśam | ārdrakopadaṃśam ~ ārdrakeṇopadaṃśam | atra vikalpenopapadasamāsaḥ “tṛtīyāprabhṛtīny anyatarasyām (Sharma’s antarasyām is a misprint)” (2.2.21) | mūlakādi copadaṃśeḥ karma | bhujeḥ karaṇam | sarvasminn evātra ṇamulprakaraṇe kriyābhede sati vāsarūpavidhinā ktvāpi bhavati | mūlakenopadaśya bhuṅkte || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ hiṃsārthānāṃ ca samānakarmakāṇām || 3.4.48 || 8 tṛtīyāyām ity eva | hiṃsā prāṇyupaghātaḥ | tadarthānāṃ dhātūnām anuprayogadhātunā samānakarmakāṇāṃ tṛtīyānte upapade ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | daṇḍopaghātaṃ gāḥ kālayati ~ daṇḍenopaghātam | daṇḍatāḍam ~ daṇḍena tāḍam | samānakarmakāṇām iti kim? coraṃ daṇḍenopahatya gopālako gāḥ kālayati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ saptamyāṃ copapīḍarudhakarṣaḥ || 3.4.49 || upaśabdaḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate | upapūrvebhyaḥ pīḍarudhakarṣebhyaḥ saptamyante upapade, cakārāt tṛtīyānte upapade, ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | pārśvopapīḍaṃ śete ~ pārśvayor upapīḍam ~ pārśvābhyām upapīḍam | vrajoparodhaṃ gāḥ sthāpayati ~ vraje uparodham ~ vrajenoparodham | pāṇyupakarṣaṃ dhānāḥ saṃgṛhṇāti ~ pāṇāv upakarṣam ~ pāṇinopakarṣam | karṣater idaṃ grahaṇaṃ na kṛṣateḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 303] samāsattau || 3.4.50 || saptamyām tṛtīyāyām iti vartate | samāsattiḥ sannikarṣaḥ | samāsattau gamyamānāyāṃ tṛtīyāsaptamyoḥ upapadayoḥ dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | keśagrāhaṃ yudhyante ~ keśeṣu grāham ~ keśair grāham | hastagrāham ~ hasteṣu grāham ~ hastair grāham | yuddhasaṃrambhād atyantaṃ sannikṛṣyante ity arthaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ pramāṇe ca || 3.4.51 || tṛtīyāsaptamyoḥ ity eva | pramāṇam āyāmaḥ, dairghyam | pramāṇe gamyamāne tṛtīyāsaptamyoḥ upapadayoḥ dhātor ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | dvyaṅgulotkarṣaṃ khaṇḍikāṃ chinatti ~ dvyaṅgule utkarṣam ~ dvyaṅgulenotkarṣam | tryaṅgulotkarṣam || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ apādāne parīpsāyām || 3.4.52 || parīpsā tvarā | parīpsāyāṃ gamyamānāyām apādāne upapade dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | śayyotthāyaṃ dhāvati ~ śayyāyā +utthāyam (see Böhtlingk; Sharma etc. give utthāya, but this would not have a connotation of haste; see the example āsanād utthāya gacchati below) | evaṃ nāma tvarate yad avaśyaṃ kartavyam api nāpekṣate | śayyotthānamātram ādriyate | randhrāpakarṣaṃ payaḥ pibati | bhrāṣṭrāpakarṣam apūpān bhakṣayati | parīpsāyām iti kim? āsanād utthāya gacchati || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ dvitīyāyāṃ ca || 3.4.53 || parīpsāyām ity eva | dvitīyānta upapade parīpsāyāṃ gamyamānāyāṃ dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | yaṣṭigrāhaṃ yudhyante ~ yaṣṭiṃ grāham | loṣṭagrāham ~ loṣṭaṃ grāham | evaṃ nāma tvarate yad āyudhagrahaṇam api nādriyate | loṣṭādikaṃ yat kiṃ cid āsannaṃ tad gṛhṇāti || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ svāṅge 'dhruve || 3.4.54 || dvitīyāyām ity eva | adhruve svāṅgavācini dvitīyānta upapade dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | akṣinikāṇaṃ jalpati | bhrūvikṣepaṃ kathayati | adhruve iti kim? utkṣipya śiraḥ kathayati | yasminn aṅge chinne 'pi prāṇī na mriyate tad adhruvam | “adravam mūrtimat svāṅgam” (Kāśikā 4.1.54) || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ [p. 304] 9 parikliśyamāne ca || 3.4.55 || svāṅge, dvitīyāyām ity eva | parikliśyamāne svāṅgavācini dvitīyānte upapade dhātoḥ ṇamul pratyayo bhavati | parikleśaḥ sarvato vibādhanam, duḥkhanam | uraḥpeṣaṃ yudhyante ~ uraḥpratipeṣaṃ yudhyante | śiraḥpeṣam ~ śiraḥpratipeṣam | kṛtsnam uraḥ pīḍayanto yudhyante | dhruvārtho 'yam ārambhaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ viśipatipadiskandāṃ vyāpyamānāsevyamānayoḥ || 3.4.56 || dvitīyāyām ity eva | dvitīyānte upapade viśyādibhyo dhātubhyo ṇamul pratyayo bhavati, vyāpyamāne āsevyamāne cārthe gamyamāne | viśyādibhiḥ kriyābhir anavayavena padārthānāṃ sambandho vyāptiḥ | tātparyam āsevā | dravye vyāptiḥ, kriyāyām āsevā | gehānupraviśam āste | samāsena vyāptyāsevayor uktatvāt “nityavīpsayoḥ” (8.1.4) iti dvirvacanaṃ na bhavati | asamāsapakṣe tu vyāpyamānatāyāṃ dravyavacanasya dvirvacanam, āsevyamānatāyāṃ tu kriyāvacanasya | tathā ca vakṣyati — “supsu vīpsā, tiṅkṣu nityatā” (Kāśikā ad 8.1.4) iti | gehaṃ geham anupraveśam āste | āsevāyām — geham anupraveśam anupraveśam āste | pati — gehānuprapātam āste ~ gehaṃ geham anuprapātam āste ~ geham anuprapātam anuprapātam āste | padi — gehānuprapādam āste ~ gehaṃ geham anuprapādam ~ geham anuprapādam anuprapādam āste | skandi — gehāvaskandam āste ~ gehaṃ geham avaskandam ~ geham avaskandam avaskandam āste | vyāpyamānāsevyamānayoḥ iti kim? geham anupraviśya bhuṅkte | nanu ābhīkṣṇye ṇamul vihita eva, āsevā ābhīkṣṇyam eva, kimarthaṃ punar āsevāyāṃ ṇamul ucyate? ktvānivṛttyartham iti cet, na, iṣṭatvāt tasya | dvitīyopapadārthaṃ tarhi vacanam, upapadasamāsaḥ pakṣe yathā syāt | tena hi sati upapadābhāvaḥ || ___________________________________________________________________________________________ asyatitṛṣoḥ kriyāntare kāleṣu || 3.4.57 || dvitīyāyām ity eva | kriyām antarayati kriyāntaraḥ,
